scope.evidence_basis: Live verify response recorded verbatim 2026-10-17 from the production worker (v2.3.0, ATC/1.0) at https://uta-trust-api.eddyflores100.workers.dev against the published conformance vector valid-atc. Card block and signature block are byte-faithful extracts of the published vector, pinned to alicelabs-llc/universal-trust-adapter commit 472329572e4fc3dff4536fffc33c135fd46609ef (2026-09-09, uta-monorepo/packages/conformance/vectors/). The response block is the verbatim HTTP body (7 emitted fields); annotations and interpretations live OUTSIDE it, in `annotations` and `provenance`. Settlement: 0.01 USDC on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) via the public x402.org facilitator, transaction 0xc7467392f0ca06c8a92d877d7224290186b35e63dece7fcd9a1c64c4971844f7, receipt carried in the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. The card is a published test vector and asserts nothing about any real agent.

request.payment: X-PAYMENT header carrying an x402 v2 payload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, USDC eip155:84532, amount 10000 = 0.01 USDC, payTo 0xfD856E89Ac88757C339c67E9717528af0cD1d7Ee)

card.provenance: verbatim extract of the published vector file valid-atc.json (pin: commit 472329572e4fc3dff4536fffc33c135fd46609ef); sha256 of the canonical signed subtree matches the published valid-atc.sha256

verify_response.provenance_note: the 7 fields below are the verbatim HTTP 200 body, in emitted order; nothing inside this object is annotated or edited

settlement_receipt.provenance_note: decoded X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE payload (base64), issued by the facilitator/rail; carried, not signed, by this service
settlement_receipt.carried_in: X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (issued by the facilitator/rail, not signed by this service)

canonical_bytes.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS over the signed subtree (the card without its signature key)
canonical_bytes.note: sha256(published canonical bytes) == verify_response.digest — any third party can recompute and re-verify the signature step without paying for a verification.

annotations.http_status: 200 (transport fact, not part of the JSON body)
annotations.service_signature: none — the response is deliberately unsigned; only the digest and the rail receipt travel with it

payer_field_quirk.observed: the response body's `payer` is 0xfD856E89Ac88757C339c67E9717528af0cD1d7Ee — the challenge payTo (recipient) — while the settlement receipt names 0x62Ce5E4cEaAFB6Ecc2fea03CD89d9017e17360b0 as the paying wallet
payer_field_quirk.ground_truth: this is what the deployed worker actually emits, not a fixture edit: the deployed script computes payer = (payload.accepted && payload.accepted.payTo) || payload.payer || null from the preceding 402 challenge, so `payer` names the recipient. The actual payer is only established by the settlement receipt.
payer_field_quirk.status: documented as a quirk in crosswalk/universal-trust-adapter.yaml (artifact_shapes.verify_response.fields.payer); fixing the field is a service change outside this crosswalk's scope

annotations.band_provenance: risk 'low' here is consistent with the maintainer-attested derivation rule in verification_pattern.band_derivation of the crosswalk (all four stages pass → low); the rule itself is attestation, not public code

recorded_verbatim: card.payload and card.signature: verbatim from the published vector valid-atc.json (pin: commit 472329572e4fc3dff4536fffc33c135fd46609ef)
verify_response: the 7 emitted fields, values as recorded from the live call
settlement_receipt: decoded X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE values as recorded
provenance.edited_vs_previous_revision: an earlier revision of this fixture showed signature.signed_at as 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z and omitted ca_key_id/evidence_hash/policy_version — that was a lossy extract, not the published value. This revision restores the byte-faithful signature block (signed_at 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z plus the three omitted fields). The verify_response values were not altered in any revision.
provenance.sepolia_transfer: Base Sepolia tx 0xc7467392f0ca06c8a92d877d7224290186b35e63dece7fcd9a1c64c4971844f7: 0.01 USDC (10000 units, 6 decimals) from 0x62Ce5E4cEaAFB6Ecc2fea03CD89d9017e17360b0 to 0xfD856E89Ac88757C339c67E9717528af0cD1d7Ee via EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization, settled by the public x402.org facilitator

finding.conclusion: The response is exactly an identity-layer verification status, so the primitive is present and `emitted` is accurate. But the canonical definition (Grade 1-3, KYC presence, principal endorsement) is broader than the artifact, so `exact` overstates the correspondence. Recorded as `partial` with the missing properties listed; this fixture stays as the checkable evidence for what `emitted` covers.

corrected_entry.inference_basis: Live 200 response for the published vector valid-atc: verified true, risk low, four per-stage outcomes, sha256 digest equal to the published canonical-bytes hash, settlement receipt on-chain (Base Sepolia tx 0xc7467392f0ca06c8a92d877d7224290186b35e63dece7fcd9a1c64c4971844f7).
